caseName: Cox v. Tennessee ex rel. Attorney General
caseNameFull: COX, GUARDIAN v. TENNESSEE, BY AND THROUGH ITS ATTORNEY GENERAL
attorneys: Thomas F. Turley, Jr., for appellant., Thomas E. Fox, Deputy Attorney General of Tennessee, and C. Hayes Cooney, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
